description: Rust MCP server, a single binary over stdio. Keeps a project's facts (stack, goal, commands) in project.faf, an IANA-registered YAML file (application/vnd.faf+yaml), with tools to create, score and fill it, write CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md from it, and estimate or compress its tokens. Install with cargo or npx.
rules: Call faf_init or faf_auto to create project.faf, then faf_score to see which slots are empty; faf_go fills the human slots with the user.
faf_init refuses to overwrite an existing project.faf, and the human slots stay empty until faf_go.
Treat project.faf as the source of the project's facts; faf_sync writes CLAUDE.md from it and faf_agents writes AGENTS.md, keeping hand-written content.
